title: Integrating Textual Information into Models of Choice and Scaled Response Data
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Methods paper: Bayesian model jointly integrating choice-based conjoint, scaled responses and text (topic) data, estimated on a cross-sectional survey about seat-package upgrades.
design_notes: Proposed model.R: MCMC estimation of the proposed model with K = 5 topics and Kullback-Leibler divergence. No regressions, no panel, no treatment timing.
data_files_note: ReadMe.txt: 'real survey dataset' with choice tasks, scaled responses and text.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
